# Greeting SVG sources

- Chat background: [JINEBGtiled.png](https://github.com/lezzthanthree/Needy-Streamer-Overload/blob/master/@Resources/Images/JINE/JINEBGtiled.png), embedded unchanged and tiled inside the chat viewport.
- Rounded chat bubbles and blue/pink chat palette: the user-supplied JINE screenshot.
- Window colors and frame reference: the supplied `window_small.png` from the profile owner's asset collection.
- Sticker: the supplied `love.png`, embedded unchanged as PNG data in `../greeting.svg`.
- Latin lettering: PixelMplus10 Regular from [the selected font directory](https://github.com/lezzthanthree/Needy-Streamer-Overload/tree/master/@Resources/Fonts).
- Chinese lettering: Zpix from the same directory.

The SVG contains outlined lettering, so it makes no external font requests. The fonts were used locally for authoring, not installed system-wide or bundled as font files. This source record does not assert a license for third-party artwork or fonts.
